title: 面向低资源开源文本到SQL模型的知识蒸馏
summary: 提出知识感知的Text-to-SQL框架，构建任务特定知识库（含模式语义、缩写、业务逻辑和查询模式），注入训练和推理过程。生成多样化合成数据并通过知识检索增强推理。在7个基准上显著提升开源和闭源LLM在低资源领域场景下的性能。
summary_en: Proposes a knowledge-aware Text-to-SQL framework that constructs task-specific knowledge bases (schema semantics, abbreviations, business logic, query patterns) and injects them into training and inference. Generates diverse synthetic data and enhances inference via targeted knowledge retrieval. Experiments on 7 benchmarks show significant improvements for open/closed-source LLMs in low-resource domain-specific settings.
